newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU TO CHANGE INDEX COMPOSITION.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU TO CHANGE INDEX COMPOSITION.

text.p: Rietumu Bank is to change the composition of its indices, taking into account changes on the bourse, it said on Thursday.

The bank said in a statement that it has included Olainfarm and Riga Jewellery in its Rietumu 16 index from June 18 as well as Rigas alus. At the same time it has excluded Ventspils fish cannery, Jekabpils sugar and Latvian Bridges.
In its more wide ranging Rietumu index, it will include Olainfarm, Riga Jewellery, Liepaja oil extraction and Daugavpils forestry.
The furniture maker Brasa has been excluded from the index.
